title: Educacion y Trabajo
welcome_lead: Social Organization includes education and work. Spain's Selectividad and Latin America's varied systems give material.
meta_desc: Spanish: education systems, work, social structure.
final_note: Como educamos es como imaginamos el futuro.

walkthroughs.body_html: Primaria, ESO (Secundaria Obligatoria), Bachillerato, Selectividad. Spain ranks varied on PISA.
Mexico's UNAM is one of the world's largest. Argentina's universities are free for nationals. Systems vary widely.
For 'la escuela prepara para el trabajo?', present pros and cons. Por un lado. por otro lado.
